```{python}
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("../../pc_package"))
from ctable import C, CTable
T1 = CTable(
    header=[[C("Batch", rs=2), C("Storage", rs=2), C("Purity (%) after month", cs=3)], ["0", "3", "6"]],
    body=[[C("A-01", rs=2), "5 °C", "99.1", "98.9", "98.7^1)^"],
          ["25 °C", "99.1", "97.2", "95.8"],
          [C("A-02", rs=3), "5 °C", "99.3", "99.0", "n.t.^2)^"],
          ["25 °C", "99.3", "97.5", "96.1"],
          ["40 °C", "99.3", "91.4^1)^", "–"]],
    caption="Purity during storage.", label="tbl-stab", align="llrrr",
    notes=[("1)", "Measured with method X."), ("2)", "Not tested.")], style="grid")
T2 = CTable(
    header=[[C("Step", rs=2), C("Parameter", rs=2), C("Unit", rs=2), C("Set point", rs=2),
             C("Acceptable range", cs=2)], ["Low", "High"]],
    body=[[C("Production bioreactor", rs=3), "Temperature^a)^", "°C", "36.5", "35.5", "37.5"],
          ["pH^b)^", "–", "7.00", "6.80", "7.20"],
          ["Dissolved oxygen", "%", "40", C("not applicable", cs=2)],
          [C("Harvest", rs=2), C("Hold time", rs=2), C("h", rs=2), "24", "0", "48"],
          ["12^c)^", "0", "24"]],
    caption="Process parameters.", label="tbl-par", align="llcccc",
    notes=[("a)", "Controlled by the jacket."), ("b)", "Measured offline with method Y."),
           ("c)", "For the chilled harvest only.")], notes_per_row=True)
```

See @tbl-stab and @tbl-par.

```{python}
#| output: asis
T1.show()
T2.show()
```
